title: Glossa delivery key index object v1 (runtimes/SPEC.md §2.1), stored at v1/keys/<sha256(key)>.json

environments.description: The environments the key may read by name. Absent in objects written before scopes existed: they read as development, preview, staging and production.

branches.description: A preview key: it also reads every branch environment (pr-<number>, br-<8 hex>).
